title: Public Matrix Selection v1
objective: Wire Sage-compatible matrix selection, deletion, swaps, setters, block mutation, and row insertion through storage-neutral plans and existing generated exact-resource or packed-prime operations

handoff.summary: Public Matrix selection, deletion, rectangular submatrices, swaps, row and column mutation, exact block mutation, and dense-ZZ row insertion now execute through one lazy storage-aware module. Exact matrices stay in generated FLINT resources and packed-prime matrices preserve uint64 or M4RI storage; common typed-Python plans provide Sage-compatible ordering, validation, and transactional staging. Focused native/dynamic tests prohibit hidden exact full-matrix exports, and a 500x500 cross-domain benchmark records low-single-digit millisecond medians.
risks: Arbitrary GF(2) selection and swaps currently traverse the packed/M4RI boundary and benchmark around 4-6 ms at 500x500; direct generated M4RI selectors remain a possible measured optimization.
Dense-ZZ insert_row deliberately requires exactly ncols entries, whereas current Sage behavior around surplus input is permissive; the stricter transactional contract is explicit and tested.
next_steps: Integrate the lane and run the focused public matrix selection test after any concurrent Matrix.py conflict resolution.
Add direct generated resource operations only where retained benchmark history demonstrates a material crossover.
